text:
Maria Chen: Quick UX check: were adding an "explain" card to rollout preview that tells operators why auto-fallback happened. Need to avoid exposing raw stacks or PII.

Jon Patel: Agreed. Suggest 3-line card: reason category, short metric snapshot (if latency), and an audit link. e.g. "reason: latency | p90: 480ms p99: 1.25s | audit: a1b2c". No stacks.

Lee Thompson: UX: default collapsed. small badge for auto vs manual fallback. color=orange for automatic, purple for operator-triggered. Hover shows timestamp and operator id.

Ashwin Rao: API sketch (will be sanitized in payloads):
```
policy_explain: reason=latency; brief="p99>1.2s on rdx-medium"; sample="<masked>..."; audit=a1b2c
```
Make sample opt-in via toggle.

Jon Patel: When reason=error we should show a normalized error class like "grpc-unavailable" or "model-timeout" plus last attempt status code. Thats actionable without noise.

Maria Chen: Also add a small CTA: "Start investigation" that opens the audit playbacks with role gating. Operators who lack access see a request-flow summary instead.

deploy-bot: rollout-preview created by @Maria Chen for policy=contingency-alpha /console/rollouts/preview/a1b2c :robot_face:

Lee Thompson: For telemetry, add a low-rate sample of full masked contexts (sample_rate_pct) tied to consent/retention. This helps tune thresholds without full logging.

Ashwin Rao: I'll add sample_rate_pct to rollout config + an internal masker for outputs. Will also emit a fingerprint id so we can group repeated fallbacks without storing PII.

Jon Patel: Can we include the candidate model variant that handled the request? Knowing what routed helps decide rollback vs adjust threshold.

Maria Chen: yes include "routed_to" as brief string. Important for quick triage.

Lee Thompson: PR review? I can look in ~45m. Maria, can you attach console mockups to the PR?

Maria Chen: will do. Aim to ship before Fridays UI freeze. Thanks all.

Ashwin Rao: PR will include masking rules, example payloads, and the config flag. Assigning reviewers: @Lee Thompson, @Jon Patel.

Maria Chen: :thumbsup:
